subject: food-technology
title: Energy Values: kcal/g
welcome_lead: 4, 4, 9, 7 — the numbers behind every food label.
meta_desc: A-Level Food Tech: kcal/g of carbohydrate, protein, fat, alcohol.

walkthroughs.body_html: Wilbur Atwater established the modern energy factors around 1900 through bomb calorimetry and digestibility studies. Modern UK labelling uses the rounded values 4/4/9/7 kcal/g.
1 kcal = 4.184 kJ. EU labelling shows both energy in kJ and kcal per 100 g. A 2000 kcal RDA is approximately 8400 kJ.
For a 100 g product with 50 g carb, 10 g protein, 20 g fat: energy = (50×4) + (10×4) + (20×9) = 200 + 40 + 180 = 420 kcal. Compare against the RDA for context.
